title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 te Rruga Mihal Grameno
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe totale 78.6 m2 i ndodhur ne nje objekt ne ndertim buze rruges Mihal Grameno,siper tregut elektrik.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste banim te nje objekti,i cili ndodhet ne faze karabina dhe pritet te perfundoje ne Shkurt te vitit 2027.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe neto 66.3 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar ne menyre shume funksionale.
Apartamenti ka dalje dhe ne nje verande te madhe me siperfaqe 29.5 m2.
Apartamenti eshte i orientuar nga juglperendimi,orientim qe mundeson nje diellezim perfekt ne pjesen me te madhe te dites.
Per me shume inforamcion mund te na kontaktoni.
title_en: Apartment 2+1 for sale on Mihal Grameno Street
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale with a total area of ​​78.6 m2, located in a building under construction on the edge of Mihal Grameno street, above the electrical market. The apartment is located on the fifth residential floor of a building, which is in the construction phase and is expected to be completed in February 2027. The apartment has a net area of ​​66.3 m2 and is organized in a very functional way. The apartment also has access to a large veranda with an area of ​​29.5 m2. The apartment is oriented to the south-west, an orientation that allows for perfect sunshine during most of the day. For more information you can contact us.
